extracted.name: Ahi Tuna Marinade
extracted.description: Ready in minutes, this easy ahi tuna marinade is a tasty combination of soy, sesame, garlic, and ginger, with red pepper flakes added to kick things up a notch.
instruction_lines: Mix soy sauce, wine, lime juice, olive oil, ginger, garlic, sesame oil, and pepper flakes until well combined.
